definitions.full: H5584. saah [ סָעָה ] verb (dubious) rush , of storm-wind (compare Arabic (and ), go quickly, run, be energetic ; Syriac make an attack upon ); — Qal Participle feminine singular סֹעָה מֵרוּחַ Psa 55:9 from rushing wind (and) from tempest ( סָ֑עַר ); Hup (not Now) Gr Dy סוּפָה or סְעָרָה . סעף (√ of following; apparently = cleave, divide ; compare perhaps Arabic , of hand, become cracked around nails etc., Lane 1364 , palm-branches with leaves on them , Id 1365 ; Ba Es 56 GFM Judg 15:8 compare cleft , ( forked ) branch , compare Buhl Lex 13 ).
